_note: Phase 3 handwritten canonical blocks for the frozen Myth vs Reality bible (tests/fixtures/stickman/beats/myth-vs-reality.recorded.json). A faithful clean-up of the bible's own prose into the new structured fields (bible schema: identity / settingBlocks / promptBlock): color names instead of hex codes, no internal ids or cross-references, only the style's allowed face modifiers. Future bibles produce these fields themselves.
